name: Zippo Pipe Lighter — Brushed Chrome
description: The Zippo Pipe Lighter differs from the standard Zippo in one critical respect: the flame is angled at 90 degrees, directing it downward into the bowl rather than straight up. This allows you to hold the lighter over the bowl and draw the flame in naturally while packing. Windproof in all conditions. Refillable with any lighter fluid. Zippo's lifetime guarantee covers everything.

name: Xikar ELX Pipe Lighter — Single Soft Flame
description: The ELX is Xikar's premium pipe lighter — a butane soft-flame with the same downward-angled design as the Zippo but with a more refined action and a flame that is less susceptible to wind without the harshness of a torch. The ergonomic body sits comfortably in the palm during a long lighting. Fully refillable. Xikar's lifetime guarantee applies.

name: Prometheus Caliber III Cigar Torch — Double Flame
description: A double-jet torch lighter designed for cigars up to 54-ring gauge — the twin flames toast the foot evenly without requiring the circular motion needed with a single torch. The slim profile fits a jacket pocket without creating a visible outline. Prometheus fill their lighters with high-purity butane before shipping so there is no need to bleed and refill before first use.

name: Cedar Spills — Bundle of 25
description: The traditional method of lighting a pipe or cigar — a thin sliver of Spanish cedar, lit from a candle or match, held over the bowl while you draw. The cedar burns at a lower temperature than a match and imparts a complementary woody note rather than the sulphur of a match head or the butane of a lighter. Twenty-five spills to a bundle, tied with waxed twine.

name: Swan Vesta Matches — 3-Box Set
description: Swan Vestas have been the pipe smoker's match of choice since 1883. The short wooden stem burns long enough to properly light a bowl without scorching your fingers, and the strike-anywhere heads are reliable in damp conditions. Three boxes of 45 matches each. The smell of a freshly struck Swan Vesta and a bowl of Virginia flake is among the more civilised experiences available to a man.

name: Colibri Quantum Single Soft Flame
description: Colibri's Quantum is a well-made single soft-flame lighter in a slim brushed-chrome case — the kind of lighter that improves with handling as the finish develops a patina. The flame angle is adjustable via a small wheel on the base; set it slightly off-vertical for bowl lighting without a separate pipe lighter. Butane-refillable. A reliable everyday carry at a sensible price.
